dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent irregular light-toned 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the mid-dorsal ridge exhibiting sharp high-contrast transitions between the dark background fur and the light ring perimeters, with internal regions maintaining the base dark intensity.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of localized high-intensity white pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, concentrated primarily in the anterior shoulder region and the lower lateral abdominal area.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Three dominant macro-annuli centroids in the central dorsal region form an obtuse scalene triangle, while a cluster of four high-intensity blobs in the neck region forms an irregular, elongated quadrilateral.
